watches.name: YALE
watches.description: Named the Offset because of our iconic "Offset" watch dial. We didn't stop there, we also offset the crown to 4 o'clock. This timepiece is also fully assembled and tested in the USA which we are very proud of. The Offset features a custom 41mm three-piece stainless steel case. A custom three-piece link bracelet with a double locking clasp. A custom dual layer dial, applied index, custom die cut hands and the date to keep everything highly detailed yet visible. This Offset has a mirror polished and brushed stainless steel finish. The link bracelet can be adjusted for the perfect fit at your local watchmaker.

watches.name: Classic
watches.description: Our very first chronograph , The Estate. Featuring a 30 minute timer and day-date indicators. The word "Opportunity" is printed on the sub-dial chapter ring where the Saturday and Sunday Icons would normally be. While most people see the weekend as a break from work and get distracted with leisure, we see it being where the opportunity to get ahead lies. "Leave A Legacy" Custom designed, engineered and machined from solid surgical grade 316L stainless steel. The 48mm case has a four-piece construction. A bezel, case, screw down case back and a custom molded brass movement holder for structural integrity. This Classic Estate has a satin brushed silver finish. Our custom shaped 316L stainless steel three-link band includes fast pins, a double locking clasp, three-place micro adjustment, removable links and includes two spare links for those with larger wrists. Case & Band 316L Stainless Steel Case Size 48mm x 11.5mm Dial Color Black Movement Swiss Ronda Z60 Lens Sapphire Crystal Band Width 24mm Water Resistance 5 ATM Interchangeable Strap Yes
